messages.subject: Stan Error:  sh.exe not found
parts:
Hello Stan People,
What do you think could be the problem; when I run stan() I encounter this error.

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! make: sh.exe: Command not found
make: *** [fileb8c020a83e09.o] Error 127

Actually,sh.exe exists and is on the search path

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan Error: sh.exe not found
parts:
Yes Daniel, It was an issue to do with the SHELL environment variable not specified in R Makeconf file.
I just edited the file: specifically adding the path to shell executable e.g:

SHELL= /bin/sh
